title: Understated Earthy Irish Sea Bass Tagine
description: A hearty and earthy Irish dish featuring sea bass, perfect for a post-workout meal, cooked in a traditional tagine pot with a creamy and cure-infused sauce.
instructions: Preheat the tagine pot over medium heat, adding a dash of oil to the bottom.
Add the sliced leeks and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mixed wild mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the irish cider and bring the mixture to a simmer, scraping the bottom of the pot.
Reduce the heat to low and add the sea bass fillets, spooning some of the sauce over the top of each fillet.
Cover the tagine pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the heavy cream and irish cheddar, cooking for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce is creamy and the cheese is melted.
Season the dish with dulse flakes and serve immediately.
